g.title: SUPPLY
g.text: 230 V AC from the installation through the M20 gland. Length excluded; terminated by a qualified electrician.

g.title: U7
g.text: Custom board in boards.md. Mains section with JAC, F0, RV1, PSU5, and PSU12 under a clip-on cover; PE bonds through the PE1 mounting standoff and links to the SELV ground at JP1. Terminal names are logical until the connector parts are selected.

g.title: FRONT
g.text: Ring terminal under a serrated washer. Doubles as the switch plate for the key board.

g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). 5 V enters on pin 2 and returns on pin 6.

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. C1 470 uF and C2 100 nF across VIN/GND. Signals and speaker are in wiring-audio.

g.title: U3
g.text: Retained module; E4 open. JD-VCC jumper absent. COM1/NO1 switch the isolated 12 V strike rail. COM2/NO2 form the potential-free gate contact. Logic pins are in wiring-io.

g.title: HTR1
g.text: 5 V film heater, about 3 W, bonded to the camera and microphone carrier. Switched by Q71 on U7.

g.title: U5
g.text: Custom board in boards.md. LED backlight supply enters on J52; logic is in wiring-io.

g.title: JOUT1
g.text: To the effeff 118 A7 strike. D1 1N4007 at the coil: cathode STRIKE+, anode STRIKE-. External cable length is installation-specific.

g.title: JOUT2
g.text: Potential-free contact for the gate controller start input. 30 V DC / 1 A design limit.
